item.title: IonQ reaches 84 Skyloom optical terminals in orbit
item.summary: IonQ’s Skyloom Global has reached 84 optical communications terminals (OCTs) installed in orbit following the latest launch of satellites for the US Space Development Agency (SDA). The deployment expands one of the largest operational laser communications payload footprints in low-Earth orbit.
